title: 第7章 石锋凝金晶元丹第8章 百宝阁出发
content_zh:
几人聊了差不多半个时辰，顾景元得到了很多消息。
就比如当初仙宫之后，不少人储物袋被拿走，虽然明面上没有人敢说什么，可私底下怨声载道，不少人离开坊市。
同时，当初被逼自爆的鬼尘子之事也没完，百鬼炼魂门自然不会轻易揭过。
几次找到金元宗和地蛮宗门讨要说法，两宗都没有理会。
百鬼炼魂门直接派人出手袭杀两宗修士，一时间陨落多位筑基修士，两边气氛紧张。
正想着，院门外走进来三人。
为首者高大魁梧，身高近九尺，面容方阔，下颌线条清晰有力，眉骨高耸，眉毛浓黑如刷的中年男子。
左侧是一位体态丰腴，长相娇媚的美妇，只不过眼角上也有有些皱纹了。
右侧则是一位男子，青色长衫，五官端正，气质儒雅如书生，看上去二十八九的样子。
“父亲，胡姨，你回来了。”
“团长，”
“...”
几人起身喊道。
石锋微微点头，在看到顾景元的时候也是一愣，察觉到修为后，又是一惊。
“顾道友，你突破了？”
顾景元笑着点头，道：“嗯，当初这边太乱，便前往其他坊市避祸，不断炼制法器出售，积攒了不少灵石，这才突破。这次来便是想在这边再去猎杀妖兽，积攒灵石的。”
石锋点了点头，随即扫了一眼众人后，又看向右侧儒雅男子，道：“这位是张明溪，炼气三层圆满，还是一位下品符箓师，接下来暂住在我们小院。”
“这是我的儿子，石卫，两个女儿，石依珊，石依琴，以及娄逸凡，顾景元。”
石锋简单介绍了一下。
“见过张道友。”

“见过张道友，”
“....”
几人拱手行礼。
“见过诸位。”
张明溪也是回礼。
聊了一会，叙旧之后，顾景元便拿出两块灵石，紧接着回到房间修炼了。
拿出一株石金草，一点点吞服，紧接着运转金灵锻元功炼化。
另一边，石锋的房间中，此刻有三人。
石锋，石卫，以及胡秋霞。
石卫率先开口，道：“父亲，顾景元如今是炼气四层后期，又缺灵石，是不是可以邀请他一起？这样我们采摘金晶果的机会也大一些。有了金晶果，再加上我们这些年保存好的灵药和积蓄，应该可以请动一位炼丹师，到时候炼制凝金晶元丹，父亲你的凝金诀便可突破到第六层，甚至修为也有机会突破炼气六层。”
石锋沉默不语。
石卫有些着急，继续道：“顾景元也是修炼的金属性功法，他肯定不会拒绝的。父亲，只要你突破炼气六层，便可去那些势力谋一个管事的差事，到时候我们便有了靠山，说不定还能通过你的关系进去，不用再每天猎杀妖兽，刀口舔血了。”
石卫着急也是无奈之举。
他的两个妹妹都是凡人，无法修炼。
若是他们那次猎杀妖兽死在了山脉，这两个妹妹可怎么办？
此刻若是能拼一把，突破炼气六层，便可搭上那些大一点的势力，有了稳定的收入和靠山。
石卫看向胡秋霞道：“胡姨，你劝劝父亲。一旦此事成了，我们就不用每日刀口舔血了。妹妹会有稳定的生活，你和父亲也能相守在一起，不用每日提心吊胆。”
content_en:
The few of them chatted for almost half an hour, and Gu Jingyuan got a lot of news.
For example, after Immortal Palace, many people's storage bags were taken away. Although no one dared to say anything openly, privately they complained and many people left the city.
At the same time, Gui Chenzi, who was forced to self-destruct in the first place, is not done yet, so the Hundred Ghosts Soul Refining Gate will not be easily uncovered.
I went to Jin Yuan Sect and Di Man Sect several times to ask for an explanation, but both sects ignored him.
The Hundred Ghost Soul Refining Sect directly sent people to attack and kill the monks of the two sects. Many foundation-building monks died in a short time, and the atmosphere on both sides was tense.
Just as he was thinking about it, three people walked in from outside the courtyard gate.
The leader is a tall and burly middle-aged man, nearly nine feet tall, with a square face, a clear and strong jaw line, high brow bones, and thick black eyebrows.
On the left is a beautiful woman with plump body and charming appearance, but there are some wrinkles at the corners of her eyes.
On the right side is a man in a green gown, with regular features and a scholarly temperament. He looks like he is in his late twenties.
"Father, Aunt Hu, you are back."
"Captain,"
"..."
Several people stood up and shouted.
Shi Feng nodded slightly, and was stunned when he saw Gu Jingyuan, and was shocked again when he noticed his cultivation.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, have you made a breakthrough?"
Gu Jingyuan nodded with a smile and said: "Well, it was too chaotic here at first, so he went to other cities to avoid trouble, kept refining magic weapons to sell, and accumulated a lot of spiritual stones, and then he broke through. This time I came here to hunt monsters and accumulate spiritual stones."
Shi Feng nodded, then glanced at everyone, then looked at the elegant man on the right, and said: "This is Zhang Mingxi, who has reached the third level of Qi Refining, and is also a low-level Talisman Master. He will stay in our small courtyard temporarily."
"This is my son, Shi Wei, my two daughters, Shi Yishan, Shi Yiqin, Lou Yifan, and Gu Jingyuan."
Shi Feng gave a brief introduction.
"I've met fellow Daoist Zhang."
"I have met Daoyou Zhang,"
"...."
Several people bowed their hands and saluted.
"I've met you all."
Zhang Mingxi also returned the gift.
After chatting for a while and reminiscing about old times, Gu Jingyuan took out two spiritual stones and then returned to the room to practice.
He took out a piece of Shijincao, swallowed it bit by bit, and then used the Golden Spirit Refining Yuan Gong to refine it.
On the other side, there were three people in Shi Feng's room at the moment.
Shi Feng, Shi Wei, and Hu Qiuxia.
Shi Wei was the first to speak and said: "Father, Gu Jingyuan is at the late stage of the fourth level of Qi Refining and lacks spirit stones. Can we invite him to join us? This way we have a greater chance of picking the Golden Crystal Fruit. With the Golden Crystal Fruit, plus the elixirs and savings we have saved over the years, we should be able to hire an alchemist to refine the Gold Condensing Crystal Essence Pill. Father, your Gold Condensation Technique can break through to the sixth level, and you may even have a chance to break through the sixth level of Qi Refining."
Shi Feng remained silent.
Shi Wei was a little anxious and continued: "Gu Jingyuan is also practicing metallic skills, and he will definitely not refuse. Father, as long as you break through the sixth level of Qi Refining, you can go to those forces to find a job as a manager. Then we will have a backer, and maybe we can get in through your connections. We no longer have to hunt monsters every day and lick blood from the knife edge."
It was helpless for Shi Wei to be anxious.
His two sisters are both mortals and cannot practice.
What would these two sisters do if they died in the mountains while hunting monsters?
If he could work hard at this moment and break through the sixth level of Qi Refining, he would be able to catch up with those larger forces and have a stable income and backing.
Shi Wei looked at Hu Qiuxia and said: "Aunt Hu, please advise father. Once this matter is done, we won't have to lick blood every day. My sister will have a stable life, and you and your father can stay together without worrying about it every day."
